PAINTING & BODYWORK · Body Repair

Body Panel Replacement in Riyadh

Body panel replacement for luxury vehicles in Riyadh — doors, wings, bonnets and structural panels fitted, aligned and refinished to match the car.

  1. Home
  2. Painting & Bodywork
  3. Body Panel Replacement

Some damage is beyond honest repair — a panel torn, kinked, stretched or corroded past the point where working it makes sense. Replacement is then the correct call, and on luxury vehicles it is exacting work: sourcing the right panel, transferring hardware and sensors, bonding or welding to the manufacturer's method, setting gaps to factory tolerances, and painting the new panel so it belongs. QSC also tells you the opposite when it is true: when a repairable panel does not need replacing.

PHOTO PENDING — BODY PANEL REPLACEMENT

When to book this service

  • A panel torn, kinked or stretched beyond proper repair
  • Corrosion that has eaten through a panel
  • A previous repair so poor that replacement is the cleaner path
  • Accident damage where the assessment recommends replacement over repair

How QSC handles it

Repair-versus-replace assessment with the reasoning explained

Panel sourcing, with the parts route discussed and agreed with you

Fitting to the manufacturer's method — fastened, bonded or welded as specified

Gap setting, refinishing with paint matching, and reassembly of hardware and sensors

Frequently asked questions

Will a replaced panel be detectable?

Done properly — correct panel, factory-method fitting, matched paint, set gaps — a replacement should read as part of the car. Where a specific car or color presents a limitation, you hear it at assessment.

Do you use original panels?

The parts route — original, OEM-supplier or quality alternative where appropriate — is discussed openly per job, with the trade-offs explained, and nothing is fitted without your agreement.

My new bumper has sensors. Is that a problem?

It is a requirement, not a problem: sensors and radars transfer to the new panel and the relevant systems are checked — and calibrated where required — as part of the job. See Radar & Camera Calibration.
